versions.changelog:
- Initial release of `huawei-cloud-cloudrobo-dispatch` skill for CloudRobo embodied-agent task management.
- Supports creating, listing, monitoring (blocking wait), canceling, and retrieving results for robot tasks within a workspace session.
- Integrates robots and execution models to run natural-language-driven tasks on target robots.
- Enforces stop conditions (max run time, iteration limits) for dispatched tasks.
- Provides detailed guidance for resolving required IDs (robot, session, exec model) and deploying services.
- Documentation updated with workflow examples and key usage scenarios.
